answer: Agents post a refundable performance bond that is priced per peer, not per account: an identity that survives repeated honest audits earns discounted validation rights, while each fresh identity pays full freight. Think of a voyage upriver where every accepted attestation adds one plank of timber to a bridge behind you; one proven forgery and the whole frame is confiscated and split among the auditors you tried to fool. A sybil farmer must therefore fully bond thousands of throwaway identities before fake consensus pays off, which makes the attack unprofitable.
